gloss: way of speaking; manner of speech

definitions.gloss: way of speaking; manner of speech; tone
definitions.explanation: The characteristic manner, style, or tone in which someone speaks.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はな}しぶりは{落|お}ち{着|つ}いている。
examples.english: His manner of speaking is calm.

examples.japanese: {話|はな}しぶりから{判断|はんだん}すると、{彼女|かのじょ}は{怒|おこ}っているようだ。
examples.english: Judging from the way she speaks, she seems to be angry.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}の{話|はな}しぶりには{説得力|せっとくりょく}があるので、{生徒|せいと}たちはよく{耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける。
examples.english: The teacher's manner of speaking is persuasive, so the students listen attentively.

notes:
Composed of {話|はな}し (speaking/talk) + ぶり (manner/style). The suffix ぶり attaches to nouns and verb stems to describe someone's characteristic way of doing something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話|はな}しぶりから{判断|はんだん}する: to judge from someone's way of speaking
- {落|お}ち{着|つ}いた{話|はな}しぶり: a calm manner of speaking
- {穏|おだ}やかな{話|はな}しぶり: a gentle way of speaking
- {話|はな}しぶりを{変|か}える: to change one's way of speaking

RELATED ぶり WORDS:
- {食|た}べっぷり: way of eating
- {飲|の}みっぷり: way of drinking
- {仕事|しごと}ぶり: way of working, work performance
- {暮|く}らしぶり: way of living, lifestyle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}: way of speaking — more common and general; focuses on how one speaks technically
- {口調|くちょう}: tone of voice — emphasizes intonation and emotional quality
- {口|くち}ぶり: way of speaking, tone — very similar to {話|はな}しぶり but slightly more focused on phrasing and word choice
